### Understanding Matrix Multiplication

Matrix multiplication is a fundamental operation in linear algebra used to combine two matrices to produce a third. Unlike simple arithmetic, it is **not commutative** (i.e., $AB \neq BA$ in general) and requires specific structural conditions to be valid.
